admin.roles.title: Roles and permissions
admin.roles.name: Name
_comment: Staff permissions and the Gestor de agendas preset (admin_panel/permissions.py). Each permission label is one full sentence saying what the person can do.
admin.roles.perm.solicitudes: Can see appointment requests and approve, reject or reassign them.
admin.roles.perm.cola: Can see today's patients and mark who arrived.
admin.roles.perm.crear_turnos: Can look up or register patients and book them appointments from the panel.
admin.roles.perm.pacientes: Can open a patient's record and correct their details and family group.
admin.roles.perm.historia_clinica: Can add background to a patient's clinical history.
admin.roles.perm.atencion_medica: Can work as a doctor: see their own appointments, patients and pre-visit interviews.
admin.roles.perm.todos_los_pacientes: Can see the patients of every doctor, not only those of the doctor linked to their account (head of service, audit). Every access is recorded.
admin.roles.perm.medicos: Can edit doctors: their schedules, working days and agenda closures.
admin.roles.perm.servicios: Can edit services, health centers and test preparation instructions.
admin.roles.perm.asistente: Can edit what the assistant knows and how it answers, and read its conversations.
admin.roles.perm.apariencia: Can change how the site looks and how staff sign in to the panel.
admin.roles.perm.configuracion: Can change site settings: languages, location and external service keys.
admin.roles.perm.hsi: Can review and resolve the HSI synchronization.
admin.roles.perm.sistema: Can see the system status and the roadmap.
admin.roles.perm.legal: Can edit the terms and conditions and the privacy policy.
admin.roles.perm.usuarios: Can create users, choose what each one can do and edit roles.
